name: SNU
label: Signature navy/gold academic deck — the ORIGINAL reference identity this toolkit was built from (navy #0F0F70 + gold #C5A86F). Measured from the reference .pptx; see DESIGN_SYSTEM.md and the design_system.html token guide. Uses the canonical OOXML component clone (snu_components.xml == the reference shapes), so PowerPoint renders the gold pill/cards/number-block faithfully.

official_ci.source: design_system.html (OOXML 전수 스캔, 9525 EMU/px) — 52-slide reference deck
official_ci.note: 이 테마는 toolkit의 원본 정체성(navy 0F0F70 + gold C5A86F)이다. recolor_map의 SOURCE 키(0F0F70/C5A86F/...)와 출력색이 동일해 클론 컴포넌트가 원본색 그대로 렌더된다. 본문은 검정(#1A1A1A) 기본, 인라인 강조(**bold**/*em*)만 빨강(bold_color/em_color #C00000)으로 통일한다. 카드 헤드·배너·번호블록·pill 등 구조 요소는 navy/gold 유지, 골드 pill 텍스트는 흰색.

banner.comment: Reference content slides are white-bg with numblock + section label + gold X.Y pill + title. The faint navy-tint header band is a generator addition; the dark navy gradient lives on the numblock and cover.

type_pt._scale_note: Reference title is Arial 24pt; standardized to 27 here. 4-size content scale: title 27, subtitle 20, body 17, caption 14 (floor). number 40 = numblock glyph.
